name: city_21
prompt:
Create ONE square finished terrain background for a premium AA-quality Three Kingdoms card-strategy game. Exceptionally crisp refined semi-realistic hand-painted 2.5D art, coherent material scale and believable matte stone/soil/wood/foliage, controlled contact shadows and soft sunlight; no watercolor blur, plastic toy look, haze, bloom, or depth of field. True steep overhead ORTHOGRAPHIC map view, no sky or horizon. Central 80% of the whole canvas is OPEN, EMPTY, CONTINUOUS FLAT GROUND traversable in all four directions. All scenic elements frame only the narrow outer 10% fringe; do not place obstacles or shadows across the center. Ground is detailed but calm and low-contrast for readable foreground cards, not giant repeated diamonds or a checkerboard. No bridge, river, pond, waterway, staircases, elevation change, central monument, dividing wall, people, cards, UI, text, icons, logo or watermark. This is ONE continuous city ground, not districts, panels or a collection of tiles.
Unique city art direction: 江陵, 松影汉庭. Ground: warm light-gray refined limestone courtyard paving, smaller precise slabs, fine chisel-cut grain and restrained edge wear. Peripheral framing: small pine canopies, imposing late-Han gray masonry corners, bronze lamps and dark timber gateposts only on the extreme outer fringe. Refined palette compatible with cream parchment, aged gold and vermilion UI.
